Streaming chat completion where the assistant responds with a tool call across multiple chunks

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "liter_llm"
api_key = ENV.fetch("API_KEY")
client = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
result = client.chat_stream(LiterLlm::ChatCompletionRequest.new(messages: [{ 'content' => 'What is the weather in NYC?', 'role' => 'user' }], model: 'gpt-4', stream: true, tools: [LiterLlm::ChatCompletionTool.new(function: LiterLlm::FunctionDefinition.new(description: 'Get the current weather for a given location', name: 'get_weather', parameters: '{"properties":{"location":{"description":"The city and state, e.g. New York, NY","type":"string"}},"required":["location"],"type":"object"}'), tool_type: 'function')])).to_a
puts result.inspect
```
